admission.justification: Together the two members guarantee both bare Pyright termination without scanning nested environments/caches and zero [tool.pyright] exclude drops on explicit file-list runs (distinguishing [tool.pyright] exclude from Pyright 1.1.414+'s independent default **/.* dot-folder exclusion), which neither member promises alone.

guarantee: Root [tool.pyright] exclude skips virtual environments, dependency trees, build outputs, and tool caches at any depth without matching any tracked Python file (including the 18 tracked files under .dagger/), so bare Pyright runs finish without scanning nested environments or caches and explicit file-list runs in .githooks/_gate.sh and quality_plan.py suffer zero [tool.pyright] exclude drops; Pyright 1.1.414+'s own default **/.* exclude applies independently to dot-folders such as .dagger/ (leaving non-dot tracked Python files, e.g. 2,544 of 2,562 on a801c47d, as the effective Pyright 1.1.414 checked set).
title: Bare and file-list Pyright runs keep [tool.pyright] exclude disjoint from tracked Python
